dct_title_s: Myanmar and Bangladesh combined administrative level 2 boundaries
dct_description_sm: Emergency GIS union of the [Bangladesh - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-bgd) administrative level 2 (district or "zila") features and [Myanmar District Boundaries MIMU v9.3](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mimu-geonode-myanmar-district-boundaries-mimu) administrative level 2 (district) features - shapefile and gazetteer.
dct_publisher_sm: Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU) and Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS)
